hooks.command: command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; project=$(realpath "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "validate-plugin hook skipped: jq is not installed" >&2; exit 0; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; f=$(realpath "$f" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; common=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; pcommon=$(git -C "$project" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ "$common" = "$pcommon" ] || exit 0; [ -f "$root/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" ] || exit 0; cd "$root" && out=$(claude plugin validate . 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
